name: cadrora
description: Galerie photo evenementielle open source, concue pour Cloudflare.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint

ADMIN_SECRET_HASH.description: Required in password mode. Generate it with `npm run setup:admin-credentials`; save the generated password in a password manager and provide only the HMAC hash here.

AUTH_PEPPER.description: Required server-only random value (at least 32 bytes) generated by `npm run setup:admin-credentials`; powers separate admin and event-password HMAC domains.

CADRORA_SEED_DEMO.description: Optional build-only flag. Set to true only for a public showcase; it enables the read-only demo and seeds generated D1/R2 content.

DB.description: Required D1 reference state. Production and preview must use separate databases.

MEDIA_BUCKET.description: Required private R2 bucket for derived event media. Do not bind a public bucket.

MODELS_BUCKET.description: Required private R2 bucket for checksum-pinned face model artifacts.

TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY.description: Required secret for login and protected-gallery unlock verification. Configure allowed hostnames in Turnstile separately.

FACE_INDEX.description: Optional Vectorize index. Leave unbound to keep face search unavailable without affecting galleries.

VITE_APP_NAME.description: Public website name compiled into the static client. The default is Cadrora.

VITE_CONTACT_ADDRESS.description: Public studio or business address. Replace the clearly labelled fictional showcase default before a real launch.

VITE_CONTACT_EMAIL.description: Public contact email. Replace the clearly labelled fictional showcase default before a real launch.

VITE_CONTACT_PHONE.description: Public contact phone number. Replace the clearly labelled fictional showcase default before a real launch.

VITE_PHOTOGRAPHER_NAME.description: Optional public photographer or studio name shown on the static website.

VITE_SERVICE_AREA.description: Public service area shown on the contact page. Replace the fictional showcase default before a real launch.

VITE_GA_MEASUREMENT_ID.description: Optional public GA4 Measurement ID. Analytics loads only after explicit consent and only on marketing routes.

VITE_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY.description: Required public site key from the same Cloudflare Turnstile widget as `TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY`.
